Autocast
wikitext:
An '''autocast''' is the ability of a skill to be used without explicit activation. While some skills such as [[Double Attack]], [[Hindsight]] and the [[TaeKwon Kid]] stances trigger skills randomly on attack, the term is generally used for cards or equipment that give a certain chance of casting skills automatically when attacking or taking damage. Autocasting does not have any [[Skills#Cast Time|cast time]], nor does it require any [[Max SP|SP]] or catalyst. Autocasting will still incur the cast delay of a skill. title: Axe
wikitext:
Axes can be used by [[Swordman]], [[Knight]], [[Crusader]], and [[Assassin]], but are generally used by [[Merchant]], [[Alchemist]], [[Blacksmith]] and [[Super Novice]] classes. Axes come in many varieties, with more slotted versions being dropped by monsters. Axes have medium-high to high [[ATK]], but have lower attack speed than [[Sword]]s or [[Dagger]]s. All axes are also naturally unbreakable (such as from party or monster skills) but can still be broken in upgrade attempts during weapon refining. {| class="wikitable" ! title: Bare Handed
wikitext:
== Overview ==
While technically not a [[Weapon]], some skills require the player to not have any Weapon equipped in order to function.

[[Category:Weapons]]

title: Book
wikitext:
Books are used by [[Priest]], [[Sage]], and [[TaeKwon Master]] classes. Books usually have slower attack speeds than other weapons, but have medium ranged [[ATK]]. Sage classes can however reach greater ASPD with Books with their passive skill [[Study]]. Books don't have many varieties, though they do come in elemental form. Books are not sold from NPCs, making them fairly rare and hard to find. Bullets
wikitext:
'''Bullets''' are a type of ammunition used by [[gun]]s, rifles, shotguns, etc., much like [[arrows]] used by [[bow]]s. Unlike [[arrows]], there are only a small variety of bullets, and they come in two types: Bullets and Catalysts. === Bullets === The basic bullets are usable with any gun with the exception of catalyst bullets (which are used by their respective gun and skills (e.g. {{Item |id=7663 Full Metal Jacket}} for Rebellion Rifle skills). title: Card Desocketing
wikitext:
Card Desocketing is a way for players to remove slotted cards from their equipment.

== How to Desocket Cards ==
:[[File:Richard-Malangdo-Renewal.png]]
Cards can be desocketed from their items by '''Richard''' {{navi|malangdo|220|160}} in [[Malangdo]]. When an item desocket fails, the card remains in the item and neither are destroyed.
#When an item is desocketed successfully, you get both the item and the card back intact.
#Any piece of equipment can be desocketed, including accessories and middle headgear. 
#All enchantments are preserved in the card desocketing process.
#* For Darklord Essence, if the gear happens to be enchantable and resetting them is an option, doing an enchant reset will remove the Darklord Essence. Does not apply to line enchants. Proof in [[Talk:Card Desocketing|Discussions tab]]

Richard's desocketing service can be paid for in one of four different ways:
#1,000,000 zeny is the basic service fee, but has a high chance of failure (works for MVP cards too).
#'''General Lubricant''' can be used to raise the chances of a successful desocketing.
#'''High Rank Lubricant''' can be used for an even greater chance of desocketing success.
#'''Silit Pong''' is the best lubricant on the market, and is reserved for MVP cards - 100% success guaranteed!

== Lubricants ==

Lubricants help ease the separation between the item and its card. They can be purchased from the '''Special Vending Machine''' {{navi|malangdo|218|165}} in Malangdo for the following exchange rates:

==Overview==
Certain bonuses are granted when using various [[Card Sets|combinations]] of cards at the same time. Most cards in sets are inserted into different pieces of equipment. Set bonus, whether from [[equipment]], [[card]] or [[enchant]] are only applied once, even if the player have multiple instances of it.

title: Card System
wikitext:
'''Cards''' are items that are installed into [[equipment]] to provide beneficial effects to the player. Equipments with slots can be installed with a card. A maximum of 4 slots are available on [[weapons]], and 1 slot for [[footgears]], [[garments]], [[accessories]], [[armors]], [[shields]] and [[headgears]].
__TOC__
== Acquiring Cards ==
You can acquire cards in different ways: 

*Most [[monster]]s in-game have a 0.01% chance of dropping their own card. 
*Some usable items give cards:
**{{item|id=616 Old Card Albums}} will create a random non-MVP card.
**{{item|id=12246 Mystical Card Albums}} give a random "mini-boss" card.
**{{item|id=13908 Class Set Card Albums}} give a random card from one of the six class sets.
*Trade for or buy one from a [[vending]] shop.
*Reward from [[Overlook Water Dungeon Quests]].

== Installing Cards ==
By double-clicking the card, you can compound the card into a piece of equipment of your choice. The card does not disappear from your inventory until you  install the card in a piece of equipment. 

To install, the equipment must have a '''slot''' available for a card to go in. Cards only install into their own specific type of equipment category. When double-clicked, you are shown list of equipment you currently have that the card can be put in to. Right click the card to see what effect it gives, and where it can be installed. 

To see if your equipment has a slot available for a card, simply mouse over the equipment in question. if it does, it'll appear with suffix <nowiki>[1]</nowiki> to <nowiki>[4]</nowiki>. An example would be "Guard [1]", which means it has 1 slot for inserting a card. Some equipment can have slots added to them via [[Socket Enchant]].

Many weapons (mainly weapons that can also be bought from [[NPC]] shops) have multiple variants with different numbers of slots. For example, "Blade <nowiki>[3]</nowiki>" is store-bought, and "Blade <nowiki>[4]</nowiki>" is dropped by monsters. If a piece of equipment is destroyed because you failed when you tried to upgrade it, the equipment and all of the installed cards will be destroyed. If a piece of equipment is damaged in battle, it will not harm the cards.
=== Sets ===
:''Main article: [[Card Sets]]
Certain bonuses are granted when using various [[Card Sets|combinations]] of cards at the same time. Most cards in sets are inserted into different pieces of equipment. Set bonus, whether from [[equipment]], [[card]] or [[enchant]] are only applied once, even if the player have multiple instances of it.

== Removing Cards ==
:''Main article: [[Card Desocketing]]
Card desocketing is a way for players to remove slotted cards from their equipment.

== Skills Gained from Cards ==
:''Main article: [[Skill Equipment#Skills bestowed from Cards|Skills bestowed from Cards]]
Some cards allow the use of skills not available normally to a certain class.

== Set Bonus with Equipment ==
:''Main article: [[Equipment Sets]]
An equipment can gain set bonus when equipped together with certain cards.

== Equipment General Overview == Equipment is a significant part of gameplay, and many players strive to constantly improve their gear. To equip a piece of gear, simply double click on it, or drag it from the inventory (alt-e) to the Equip window (Alt-Q). The character will have to be the required class, and over the required minimum level specified on the item. Some items are also for [[transcendent]] classes only. For new players, completing the [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] is highly recommended. These offer basic "free" gears, which are quite good already. However, note that these gears are all character bound, meaning you cannot even move them within storage to other characters on the same account. Each character will therefore have to complete the quests again. When ready to move on to more advanced gears beyond Eden gears, the selection could be quite daunting. Often, the exact same gears can be shared among multiple classes, at least within the PVM / MVP sector. For WoE / PVP, gears differ quite a bit and much focus is put onto stacking [[Demi Human]] reductions for better survivability, and usually includes the WoE set. There are of course exceptions to every case, especially concerning [[Ranger]]s who mostly use the White Wing Set as their default gear. The main piece of equipment that tends to differ is the [[weapon]], although certain weapons can be shared as well among similar classes, like how [[Royal Guard]]s and [[Rune Knight]]s can both equip [[Spears]]. "Luxury" items are mostly for reference and regular players usually cannot afford these. God Items in particular tend to be shared by many members within large guilds who have accumulated the parts over a long period of time. == Skills Gained from Equipment == :''Main article: [[Skill Equipment]] Some equipment allow the use of skills not available normally to a certain class. == Equipment Sets == :''Main article: [[Equipment Sets]] When equipped together, some equipment will give set bonus. == Weapons == The weapon is often the most important factor to the character's damage output, and is the first thing to improve upon. Eden weapons are quite good, and are often better than [[NPC]] bought weapons. Some players that are more experienced may wish to skip the Eden quest however, and sometimes will just buy the strongest NPC weapon available. The [http://db.irowiki.org/ database] iRO Wiki hosts offers very good searching capabilities. The "Weapon Search" page within the "Item" category allows the user to specify different criteria to search by. One good method is to specify the class, choose to sort by "ATK", and view the strongest weapons available. For magic classes, choose "MATK" instead. Weapons that are not buyable from NPCs can be bought from other players, or can be hunted from the monster(s) that drops it. For endgame purposes, it is recommended to look at the specific third class's page to see what the best weapons available for each class are. For leveling purposes on new or lower leveled characters, generally the highest ATK or MATK weapons that the character can equip at their level are adequate. The [[Weapons]] page lists the different types of weapons and ammunition. == Garments == Normally, a garment is used mainly for helping reduce damage a character takes. This is especially important for classes that cannot equip a shield at all times due to having to use a two-handed weapon. Garments are often used for [[Neutral]] reduction, which can reduce the damage a monster's regular melee attacks can inflict as well as certain skills that have neutral element. === Luxury === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! Increases damage taken from Holy and Ghost property attacks by 100%. | Offers the best [[elemental]] reduction, but must be careful against neutral, Holy, and Ghost attacks. |- |{{Item List |id=2541 |item=Asprika}} | 94+ | Honorable mention only | Albeit being a God Item, Asprika is mostly outshone by other garments currently. |} === High End === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! [[Spell (Enchant)|Spell]] enchants are not only extremely useful for magic users, but are applicable to many other classes as well as most skills have variable [[cast time]]. [[Expert Archer]] enchants are also popular as many classes' primary skills are ranged. |- |{{Item List |id=2576 |item=Heroic Backpack |slots=1 }} | All | Offers useful effects, provided the character has 90 or higher of a certain [[stat]]. | A good well rounded garment, with beneficial bonuses that help most classes. |- |} === Mid End === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! However, it appears it may be currently broken ([http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/98118-harpy-card-vs-raydric-card/?p=1098492 link]). |- |} ''See also: [[Card_Reference#By_element_.28garment.29 | Elemental Damage Reduction (By garment)]]'' == Armors == One very important function of an armor is the ability to change the character's [[element]] (level one always). In all cases except for [[Ghost]], wearing the particular element armor will reduce damage from that element, which is absolutely necessary to reduce an MVP's elemental skill, and also even for some regular monsters. Each element has a card for it, but certain armors such as Lucius's Fierce Armor of Volcano [1] also change a character's element by default. Note: do NOT card an elemental armor such as a Lucius's Fierce Armor of Volcano [1] (fire property) with another elemental card (like a Swordfish Card for water). The card will OVERWRITE the existing element with the card's element (fire overwritten by water). ''Reference: [[Card_Reference#Elemental_Armor | Elemental Armor]]'' Aside from element change, armors can also offer increased [[HP]], increased [[ATK]] and [[MATK]], and other small bonuses. === Luxury === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! However, this is no substitute for situations where elemental armor is needed. |} === High End === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! Equipment or Card !! Req. Lvl !! Notable Effect(s) !! Having a slot gives the option of putting in a card like a Marc Card to offer both [[freeze]] immunity and [[Fire]] element at the same time. |- |{{Item List |id=2349 |item=Aebecee's Raging Typhoon Armor |slots=1}} | 45+ | Changes the user to [[Wind]] element. | Used in a similar manner as a Lucius armor, but with [[Wind]] element. |- |{{Item List |id=2365 |item=Orleans's Gown |slots=1}} | 55+, [[transcendent]] | Prevents skill casts from being interrupted, increases the variable cast time of skills by 15%. | Has less penalty than a Phen Card while also preventing casts from being interrupted. Many classes and not just [[Mage]] classes have skills that need this attribute. |- |{{Item List |id=2357 |item=Valkyrian Armor |slots=1}} | [[Transcendent]] classes | Indestructible, all stats +1 | Only used for the indestructibility attribute, which is not often needed. A more basic, lighter armor can be used instead if indestructibility is not needed. |- |{{Item List |id=4105 |item=Marc Card}} | All | Gives immunity to [[Frozen]] status. | Necessary in many MVP situations, and can be compounded onto an armor that changes the user's element. |- |{{Item List |id=4099 |item=Pasana Card}} | All | Changes the user to [[Fire]] element. | The [[Fire]] element is very common and having a Fire armor is recommended for all players. |- |{{Item List |id=4409 |item=Agav Card}} | All | Increases magic damage by 5%. | A good card for [[Mage]] classes for increasing MATK output. |} === Mid End === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! Note that only [[Swordsman]] and [[Merchant]] classes can equip this. |} === Economy === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! Equipment or Card !! Req. Lvl !! Notable Effect(s) !! Notes |- |{{Item List |id=2353 |item=Odin's Blessing |slots=1}} | 65+ | Some small set bonuses with other gears | A basic armor that is sometimes useful if using the other gear it has set bonuses with |- |{{Item List |id=2354 |item=Goibne's Armor}} | 54+ | Max HP +10% | Gives the same effect as a Pecopeco card. |} ''See also: [[Card_Reference#Inflicting_.28armor.29 | Status Inflicting Cards (Armor)]]'' == Footgear == Footgear is mostly used for increasing [[HP]] and [[SP]], and is vital for increasing a character's HP pool and SP pool. === Luxury === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! Notes |- |{{Item List |id=2418 |item=Vidar's Boots}} | 65+ | Max HP +9%, Max SP +9% | Offers a decent amount of HP and SP, and also can be worn by pre-[[transcendent]] characters. |- |{{Item List |id=2424 |item=Tidal Shoes |slots=1}} | 55+, [[transcendent]] | Max HP +10% when used in combination with {{Item List |id=2528 |item=Wool Scarf |slots=1 |simple=yes}} | Has an HP bonus with Wool Scarf, and also offers a slot for even more HP or SP when carded. |- |{{Item List |id=4070 |item=Eggrya Card}} | All | SP Regen +15% | Useful for regenerating SP. |} ''See also: [[Card_Reference#EXP_increase_.28shoes.29 | EXP Increase (Shoes)]]'' == Shields == A shield is very important on reducing damage a character takes, as its name suggests. Usually, the shield itself does not provide the most important aspect of reduction, and the card inside is what's important. They take up the Right Hand slot in the equipment window. As such, when a character is wielding a two-handed weapon, they cannot wear a shield (although they can certainly gear swap mid battle to a shield). Racial Reduction cards are very useful and are the most popular type of card used. It is recommended that most players create a collection of shields with the most common racial reduction cards in them. Cheaper cards can also be put into cheaper shields and do not necessarily always need the benefits higher end shields provide. ''Reference: [[Card_Reference#By_race | Shield Reduction Card (By Race)]]'' Other reductions are also available as well, by size and by monster element. Monster element cards tend to be not as popular, because they only offer 20% reduction and many maps do not have monsters with the same element. Reduces damage received from [[Undead]] race by 10%. | Not to be overlooked, this shield offers the same reduction as a Hodremlin Card except for [[Small]] monsters, as well as [[Undead]] race monsters. Note that this shield does not have a slot. |} === Economy === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! Equipment or Card !! Req. Lvl !! Notable Effect(s) !! Notes |- |{{Item List |id=2147 |item=Round Buckler |slots=1}} | 22+, [[transcendent]] | Can be shared by all classes, light weight, good DEF | A very good well-rounded low cost shield to put cheaper cards in. |} == Headgears == There is an immense number of headgears in the game, some of which are dropped from monsters, some created from certain ingredients, some available from certain quests, and some available only from [[Kafra Shop]]. Some headgears are almost used only for aesthetic purposes as well. ''For miscellaneous information on headgears, please see [[headgears]].'' === High End === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! Equipment or Card !! Req. Lvl !! Notable Effect(s) !! Notes |- |{{Item List |id=18539 |item=Skull Cap |slots=1}} | 10+ | Set bonus with {{Item List |id=1636 |item=Thorn Staff of Darkness |simple=yes}} or {{Item List |id=1615 |item=Evil Bone Wand |simple=yes}}: Each refine on the weapon adds Matk+10. If the weapon is refined to +10 or higher, reduces the variable cast time of skills by 10%. | A very popular headgear for magic users due to the combo with Thorn Staff of Darkness. |- |{{Item List |id=18652|item=Vanargand Helm|slots=1}} | 80+ | Apparently offers higher SP leech proc rates compared to {{Item List |id=5208|item=Rideword Hat|slots=1|simple=yes}} when upgraded to +9 or higher. | Very useful for physical classes (both melee and ranged) for leeching SP back. |- |{{Item List |id=18656 |item=Witch's Pumpkin Hat}} | 20+ | With {{Item List |id=5086 |item=Alarm Mask |simple=yes}}, this combo is currently one of the most effective healing item boosting gear with {{Item List |id=535 |item=Pumpkins |simple=yes}}. | However, this does take up all headgear slots. For more information on healing items, please see [[Healing_Items#Healing_Boosters|Healing Boosters]]. |- |{{Item List |id=5564 |item=Crown of Deceit |slots=1}} | 85+ | Reduces the variable cast time of skills by 10%, and even more if upgraded to +7 or +9 or beyond. | Offers a very high amount of variable cast time reduction. Sometimes used by non-[[Mage]] classes too for cast reduction. |- |{{Item List |id=4366 |item=Kathryne Keyron Card}} | All | Each upgrade on the headgear reduces the variable cast time of skills by 1%. | A highly sought after card for the cast reduction. |- |{{Item List |id=4241 |item=Arc Angeling Card}} | All | If the user's base Luk is 77 or higher: HP Regen +100%, SP Regen +100% | A very useful card for [[Arch Bishop]]s and sometimes other classes for the SP regen, but does require 77 LUK. |- |{{Item List |id=4336 |item=Ungoliant Card}} | All | Gives immunity to [[Bleeding]] status. | Useful in many PVM situations, as [[Bleeding]] will prevent natural SP regen. |- |{{Item List |id=18611 |item=Black Frame Glasses |slots=1}} | All | Slotted mid headgear, [[INT]] +1, [[MDEF]] +2 | Currently the best mid headgear available. Equipment or Card !! Req. Lvl !! Notable Effect(s) !! Notes |- |{{Item List |id=5208 |item=Rideword Hat |slots=1}} | 40+ | Adds a 1% chance to restore 4% of the damage dealt as SP to the user with each physical attack. (Amount restored increased if +9 or higher) | A useful headgear for physical classes (both melee and ranged) to leech SP back when attacking. |- |{{Item List |id=5363 |item=Abysmal Knight Helm |slots=1}} | 70+ | Reduces damage received from [[Boss]] monsters by 10%, reduces damage received from [[Demi Human]] race by 10%. | Useful for MVP situations to reduce more damage. |- |{{Item List |id=2204 |item=Glasses |slots=1}} | All | A simple slotted mid headgear. | Offers a slot for a mid headgear, and is usually adequate and a Black Frame Glasses [1] is not worth the extra cost for 1 INT. |} ''Reference: ''[[Card_Reference#By_element_.28headgear.29| Elemental Resist Cards (Headgear)]]'' == Accessories == Many accessories, as the name implies, offers some alternative useful abilities, such as [[Teleport]] and [[Heal]]. Because of this, the user can sometimes switch to the accessory to perform that particular function, and swap back to another one more oriented for battle. Note that accessories cannot be upgraded. ''For a list of accessories, check [[accessories]] or use the database to search for a list.'' === Luxury === {| class="wikitablec sortable" ! Equipment or Card !! Req. Lvl !! Notable Effect(s) !! Notes |- |{{Item List |id=2629 |item=Megingjard}} | 94+ | [[STR]] +40, further increases the user's STR by [Base Level / 5]. | Adds a very high amount of STR that no regular accessory can compare with. |- |{{Item List |id=2630 |item=Brisingamen}} | 94+ | Adds 6-10 of each STAT, increases the recovery power of the user's healing skills by 6%. | Adds quite a bit of STATs, one of which is +10 [[INT]]. Note that these accessories are account bound once opened from the box. |- |{{Item List |id=2967 |item=Chambered RWC 2012 Ring |slots=1}} | All | Can be enchanted with various [[Fighting Spirit]] or [[ATK]] enchants (please see [[RWC Accessory Enchants]]). | A good accessory for physical ATK (both ranged and melee) classes. Notable Effect(s) !! Equipment or Card !! Req. Lvl !! Notable Effect(s) !! Notes |- |{{Item List |id=4327 |item=Bloody Butterfly Card}} | All | Prevents skill casts from being interrupted, increases the variable cast time of skills by 30%. | Sometimes used when a Phen Card or Orleans's Gown is not affordable for the player, although it does have some other set bonuses. |- |{{Item List |id=4051 |item=Yoyo Card}} | All | P.Dodge +5, [[AGI]] +1 | A good accessory for tanking, as 5 perfect dodge can be quite useful. |- |{{Item List |id=2873 |item=Cat Hand Glove |slots=1}} | All | [[AGI]] +1, [[VIT]] +1, [[DEX]] +1, [[LUK]] +1 | Offers a few STAT bonuses and can be worn by all classes and levels, light weight. |- |{{Item List |id=2607 |item=Clip |slots=1}} | All | MAX SP +10, bonuses with Spiritual Ring | Also can be worn by all classes and levels, light weight. |} {{Navbox_Item}} [[Category: Items]]

title: Hair Styling
wikitext:
:''See [[Clothes Dye]] for further character sprite customization options or use [https://costume.irowiki.org/ iRO Wiki's Character Sprite Simulator] to find your perfect look.'' == Hair Styling == There are a few ways to change your hairstyle and hair color after your character is created. These methods will be described below but the simplest method is to find a '''Stylist''' NPC. === Default Hair Options === These are the standard hair options available to all characters upon character creation or for 100,000 zeny at any '''Stylist''' NPC. [[File:February_2024_IRO_Hairstyle_Reference_Chart.png]] === Premium Lighthalzen Hairstyles === {{Quest Info | levelreq = 70 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = 3 {{Item List|id=973|item=Counteragent|simple=yes}}
3 {{Item List|id=974|item=Mixture|simple=yes}}
100 {{Item List|id=1020|item=Black Hair|simple=yes}}
100 {{Item List|id=7152|item=Glossy Hair|simple=yes}}
100 {{Item List|id=1060|item=Golden Hair|simple=yes}}
100 {{Item List|id=901|item=Daenggie|simple=yes}}
100 {{Item List|id=1094|item=Short Daenggie|simple=yes}}
{{item|id=6290 Hairstyle Coupon}} (Non-VIP) | zenyreq = 99,800 Zeny | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = | qreward = Lighthalzen Hairstyle Change }} The unique '''Hair Dresser, Prince Shammi''' {{Navi|lhz_in02|100|143}}, inside the '''[[Lighthalzen]] Item Shop''', offers a small item collection quest to grant access to new, premium hairstyles. * Note that there are actually two matching NPCs next to each other, but the one on the right is just a normal '''Stylist''' NPC. '''Prince Shammi''''s new hairstyles are not provided by any other stylists. You must bring several different items and have [[VIP]] (even 1-day or Mini VIP is sufficient) or a {{item|id=6290 Hairstyle Coupon}} obtained from the [[File:Cashshop.gif]] [[Kafra Shop]] to change to one of these hairstyles. [[File:February_2024_IRO_Premium_Hairstyle_Reference_Chart.png]] === 4th Job Hairstyles === On 11/4/2024, a new set of hairstyles were added. Despite their name, these are not exclusive to any job class and these hairstyles can be accessed through the '''Stylist''' NPC, with the added cost of 3,000,000 zeny. *These styles also have unique colors that cannot be accessed with dye in the game, your character must start with the "default" hair color when it is created, then the hairstyle changed at the stylist NPC to see these unique colors. If you change to a different color other than the default, you will not be able to get the default color again. [[File:4th_Job_Class_Hairstyles.png]] == How to Change Hair Styles == === Criatura Academy === This method can be quite useful when creating a booster character, but can also be used for any new human character you create. It is completely free and requires no items. The only caveat is that you '''must''' be a novice to use this service, so if you change classes you cannot use the coupon. Please note you can only select hairstyles 1-19.

[[File:Criatura Academy Map.png]]

1. As a novice, head to '''Izlude''' and go to the northern part of the map to reach the '''Criatura Academy''' {{Navi|izlude|128|256}}.

[[File:CriaturaAcademyRegister.png]]

2. Speak with the '''Academy Receptionist NPC''' {{Navi|iz_ac01|100|39}} at the counter when you first enter and register for the '''Criatura Academy'''. Note that you do not have to complete any of the other quests here, you will receive your '''Criatura Hair Coupon''' after talking to the NPC.

[[File:CriaturaAcademyLeft.png]]

3. After speaking with the '''Academy Receptionist''', you should have a '''Criatura Hair Coupon'''. Go slightly past the desk and head down the left side hallway, which leads into another room where you will see an NPC named '''Otter Samssoon''' {{Navi|iz_ac01|69|36}}.

[[File:CrituraAcademyOtterSamssoon.png]]

4. Click on '''Otter Samssoon''' and he will present you with options to view each hair style 1-19, as well as the option to change your hairstyle. This is rather tedious to look through if you don't know which hair corresponds to each number, so a chart is provided above on each hairstyle, its corresponding number, name and color. Be careful not to select to change your hair until you're absolutely sure you know which style you want, as this will use your only chance to change your hair for free at this NPC. === Stylists === [[File:Stylist.png]]

There are several '''Stylist''' NPCs in different towns at the locations listed below that offer hair styling services. They are identified by the stylist symbol [[File:StylistIcon.png]] hovering above them. Click the links to copy coordinates and paste into your chat box in-game: *'''Stylist Jovovich''' in Prontera {{Navi|prt_in|243|168}} *'''Stylist Maxi''' in Juno {{Navi|yuno_in04|186|21}} *'''Stylist Aesop''' in Rachel {{Navi|ra_in01|186|148}} *'''Stylist Prince Shammi''' in Lighthalzen {{Navi|lhz_in02|100|141}} *'''Stylist Lonza''' in Lasagna {{Navi|lasagna|134|113}} *'''Stylist Veronica''' in Alberta {{Navi|alberta|135|37}} Each Stylist provides the same service to change from [[Human]] hairstyles 1-34 and [[Doram]] hairstyles 1-6 in exchange for a 100,000z fee. The exception is '''Prince Shammi''' in [[Lighthalzen]] who offers unique options L1-L7 in '''Lighthalzen''' for humans in exhange for items and zeny, elaborated on below. Hair color can be changed for an additional 100,000z. [[File:StylistHairChange.gif]] Costume changes are available in the stylist menu if you have a '''Second Costume Ticket'''. Costume color can also be changed if you have an '''Omni Clothing Dye Ticket''' obtained from the [[File:Cashshop.gif]] [[Kafra Shop]]. Each salon also has outdated assistant NPCs that offer hair color and hairstyle changes. [[File:StylistAccessoryMenu.png]]
There is also a very limited accessory tab in the stylist menu. It allows you to view and buy very basic accessories (sent through the mail), but the Kafra and Horse accessories are not for sale. === Assistants === [[File:AssistantRossa.png]]
*'''Assistant Sena''' {{Navi|lasagna|132|116}} *'''Assistant Rossa''' {{Navi|lhz_in02|100|134}} *'''Assistant Kukri''' {{Navi|prt_in|253|169}} *'''Assistant Paulgen''' {{Navi|alberta_in|56|146}} These NPCs will offer 2 different services. For 1000z and dyestuff they will dye your hair. The second service is to change your hairstyle (1-23) for the items listed below. *This method is not recommended if you want to change from styles 1-24 because the '''Stylist''' NPC does this for 100,000z and requires no items. 3 {{Item List|id=973|item=Counteragent|simple=yes}}
3 {{Item List|id=974|item=Mixture|simple=yes}}
100 {{Item List|id=1020|item=Black Hair|simple=yes}} ({{monster|id=1170 Sohee}})
100 {{Item List|id=7152|item=Glossy Hair|simple=yes}} ({{monster|id=1404 Miyabi Doll}})
100 {{Item List|id=1060|item=Golden Hair|simple=yes}} ({{monster|id=1143 Marionette}}, {{monster|id=1390 Violy}})
100 {{Item List|id=901|item=Daenggie|simple=yes}} ({{monster|id=1026 Munak}})
100 {{Item List|id=1094|item=Short Daenggie|simple=yes}} ({{monster|id=1188 Bongun}})
99,800 Zeny '''Assistant Beautician''' {{Navi|lhz_in02|91|155}} will offer hairstyles 1-23 for 250,000z, but appears to be an outdated NPC considering the '''stylists''' do the same for 100,000z. [[File:AssistantBeautician.png]]
=== Random Hair Stylist === [[File:HairDresser-RuiVishop.png]] '''Roving Hair Dresser''', Rui Vishop {{Navi|alberta|33|141}}, will change your hairstyle ''randomly'' for 198,000z. === Premium Lighthalzen Hairstyles === [[File:PrinceShammi.png]] '''Hair Dresser, Prince Shammi''' {{Navi|lhz_in02|100|143}} can be found inside the '''Lighthalzen Item Shop'''. There are actually two of him, but the one on the right is just a normal '''stylist''' NPC. '''Prince Shammi''' offers new hairstyles not provided by the other stylists. You must have '''VIP''' (1-day VIP is sufficient) or a {{item|id=6290 Hairstyle Coupon}} obtained from the [[File:Cashshop.gif]] [[Kafra Shop]]. See [[Counteragent and Mixture Quest]] to obtain counteragent and mixture. '''Hair''' is dropped by the various monsters listed. Requirements listed below: *[[Base Level]] 70 or above. *3 {{Item List|id=973|item=Counteragent|simple=yes}} *3 {{Item List|id=974|item=Mixture|simple=yes}} *100 {{Item List|id=1020|item=Black Hair|simple=yes}} (dropped by {{monster|id=1170 Sohee}}) *100 {{Item List|id=7152|item=Glossy Hair|simple=yes}} (dropped by {{monster|id=1404 Miyabi Doll}}) *100 {{Item List|id=1060|item=Golden Hair|simple=yes}} (dropped by {{monster|id=1143 Marionette}} and {{monster|id=1390 Violy}}) *100 {{Item List|id=901|item=Daenggie|simple=yes}} (dropped by {{monster|id=1026 Munak}}) *100 {{Item List|id=1094|item=Short Daenggie|simple=yes}} (dropped by {{monster|id=1188 Bongun}}) *1 {{item|id=6290 Hairstyle Coupon}} (Not need if under [[VIP]] Buff) *99,800 Zeny == Dye Creation == {{Quest Info | levelreq = None | joblevelreq = | classreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = Herbs (Varies), {{item|id=973 Counteragent}}/{{item|id=974 Mixture}} (Varies), {{item|id=713 Empty Bottle}} (Varies) | zenyreq = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = 1 or more type of Dyestuffs | qreward = }} # Proceed to [[Morroc]] with the Herbs, {{item|id=973 Counteragent}}/{{item|id=974 Mixture}}, and {{item|id=713 Empty Bottles}}. # Enter the house in the top right corner, and talk to Java Dullihan. # Select the '''Make Dyestuffs''' option. # Next, choose which color dye is desired to create. # Choose the Make Dyestuffs option again. == Dye/Mixture/Counteragent Ingredients == To create Counteragent and Mixture, make sure you have finished the [[Counteragent and Mixture Quest]]. {{:Dye Ingredients}} {{Navbox Character Customization}}

Healing Items
wikitext:
{{Update}}
In Ragnarok Online, there are [[items]] are used to restore HP and SP. Many HP and SP restoring items can be bought from [[NPC]]s. Some HP restoring items are monster drops only as well. There are also items that can recover both at the same time. Double clicking an item in the inventory will consume it, but healing items are placed onto hotkeys for usage most of the time.

''See calculations on restoring HP and SP in the [[Restoration Calculation]] article.''

==Popular Restoring Items==
===Popular HP Restoring Items===
Most popular HP restoring items are buyable from NPCs, especially for leveling up lower level characters and general [[PvM]]. For more competitive endgame means like [[War of Emperium]] and [[MVP]] hunting, more expensive items like condensed white potions (otherwise known as "slims") are used, and are often [[Potion_Creation#Fame_System|ranked]] too. These are normally either supplied by the guild, or bought from [[Vending|vendors]].

|}

===Popular SP Restoring Items===
Light Blue Potions can be purchased from the [[Kafra Shop]] and are a very effective SP restoring item. Many new players like to hunt for Strawberries as they can be sold to other players for a decent amount of [[zeny]].

For [[PvM]] purposes, [[Magnificat]] can greatly cut down the use of SP restoring items, and [[Scholar]]s and [[Sorcerer]]s are an effective support class due to their ability to provide SP to [[party]] members with [[Soul Exhale]] and their ability to generate SP by trading away HP using [[Indulge]].

title: Huuma Shuriken
wikitext:
[[Ninja]]-only weapons, used for the skill [[Throw Huuma Shuriken]]. Typically acquired through item quests, and are all two-handed. Huuma Shurikens have a low base [[ASPD]], reducing their usefulness for melee attacking. This weapon class includes the highest base-attack weapon the Ninja can equip, the Huuma Blaze Shuriken, useful for raising the damage of [[Throw Shuriken]] and [[Throw Kunai]]. title: Ice Pick
wikitext:
{{Delete|reason=This page is not needed.}}

== Ice Pick ==
The Ice Pick is a weapon often found useful for [[Melee]] characters. It's appeal is that it inflicts higher damage on targets that have high levels of [[DEF#Soft DEF|VIT DEF]] and [[DEF]] (Increasing VIT DEF, as with [[Angelus]] will increase the damage from an Ice Pick). The more DEF and VIT DEF the target has, the more damage the ice pick will do. Previous to the Ice Pick's implementation to the game, the only way to damage targets with high DEF was to use [[Critical]] attacks ([[Crit]]), VVVS Forged Weapons, or the [[Monk]] skill, [[Occult Impaction]].

==Formula==

In pre renewal, IP increase the damage in % according to the total def of target (decrease to targets with low def and increase to targets with high def). In renewal, with the changes in def stats (influence of stats in soft def, and changes of def add for equips), IP changed your damage formula, works only with hard def (equip def) and add damage like ATK bonus (+ATK).

Pre renewal formula: [ATK * ( (Soft DEF + Hard DEF) /100)]

Renewal formula: [ATK + ((Hard DEF) /2)]

where [ ] denotes flooring

== Obtaining the Ice Pick ==

The Ice Pick is obtained by completion of the [[God Items Quest]] by an [[Assassin]] or [[Assassin Cross]] type character of [[Levels#Base Level|Base Level]] 70 or higher. Ice Picks can also be obtained from the following [[MVP]]s. The numbers in parenthesis notate the rate at which an Ice Pick will drop from the [[MVP]].

* {{monster|id=1647 Assassin Cross Eremes}} (15%)

* {{monster|id=1373 Lord of the Dead}} (0.11%)

* {{monster|id=1623 RSX 0806}} (0.06%, Unslotted) (0.02% Slotted)

title: Katar
wikitext:
Katars are weapons that can only be equipped by the [[Assassin]] class. Katars are a two-handed weapon, so you cannot wear a [[shield]] if you are using one. [[Sonic Blow]], [[Grimtooth]], [[Rolling Cutter]], and [[Cross Ripper Slasher]] can only be used with Katars. The [[Critical|critical rate]] is doubled with katar-type weapons (not shown in the status window). In spite of the fact that a katar-wielding Assassin has a blade in each hand, it counts as a single Two-Handed weapon rather than two dual-wielded weapons, so [[Righthand Mastery]] and [[Lefthand Mastery]] have no effect on them. {| class="wikitable" !Size||Damage |- |[[Small]]||75% |- |[[Medium]]||100% |- |[[Large]]||75% |} == [http://db.irowiki.org/db/weapon-search/?search&type=11&sort=1,1 List] == {| class="wikitable sortable" !Name ||Possible Slots ||Level ||Attack ||Weight ||Element || class="unsortable" | Additional Notes |- |{{Item List |id=1290 |item=Agent Katar|simple=yes}} ||1 ||3 ||170 ||120 ||[[Neutral]] ||[[HIT]] + (Base [[LUK]]). '''Maces''' are a blunt weapon type usable by [[Acolyte]], [[Swordman]], [[Merchant]], and [[Super Novice]] classes. Maces come in many varieties, with more slotted versions being dropped by monsters. Maces have medium to medium-high [[ATK]] or focus on [[MATK]] for magic-based classes. They also have the least size penalties of any weapon type. All maces are also naturally unbreakable (such as from party or monster skills) but can still be broken in upgrade attempts during weapon refining. {| class="wikitable" !Size||Damage |- |Small||75% |- |Medium||100% |- |Large||100% |} == List == Note: Forge denotes the Blacksmith ability [[Smith Mace]]. title: Overseas Care Package
wikitext:
== Overview == This page keeps a record of Overseas Care Package and Yggdrasil Ascension in Cash Shop. For other kinds of Cash Shop products like [[Kachua's Secret Key]], please check [[Kafra Shop Box Archives]]. An Overseas Care Package (OCP) is a Kafra Shop exclusive loot box that contains very strong equipment, usually from jRO. Every OCP is not always available in iRO. At certain times there will be a '''Fire Sale Event''', where all past Overseas Care Packages will be on sale again in Cash Shop. However, the latest OCP will always be available in the Kafra Shop. From OCP 1 to OCP 29, every OCP is accompanied with [[Grandma Boxter]], where you can trade in two identical products to a new OCP box. From time to time, there is an Overseas Care Package Remix, but it is '''not''' available with Grandma Boxter. After OCP 29, there are six Yggdrasil Ascension events, which give increased rate for rare items. Each Yggdrasil Ascension is also accompanied with [[Grandma Boxter]]. After 6 Yggdrasil Ascension events, OCP with [[Grandma Boxter]] is restored (since OCP 30). Since OCP 40, there is a OCP Token Exchange System together along with [[Grandma Boxter]], where you have an extra chance to get OCP equipment and guaranteed rare item with certain number of OCP boxes. It is notable that not every in-game description of OCP items are fully correct. [[List of Items with Faulty Description]] records the known faulty descriptions. == OCP Token Exchange System == Each OCP, starting from [[Overseas_Care_Package#Overseas_Care_Packages_40_and_on|OCP 40]], will include a character-bound {{Item List 2 |id=1001070 |item=OCP Exchange Token |num=1 |simple=yes}} For every 40 OCP Exchange Tokens you collect, you will be able to exchange them at our new NPC, '''Timmy Boxter''' {{Navi|moc_paraup|19|166}}, for another chance at one of this month's OCP items (at random).
[[File:Timmy_Boxter_Location.JPG|150px]] By spending 40 OCP Exchange Tokens, you can get 1 random OCP reward of increasing rarity (from the current month's OCP). Each time a random reward is exchanged, you get 1 OCP Point that is character-bound .
When you are about to reach your 5th point, you will automatically get a SSS class (0.34%) item from current month's OCP instead. All points will be reset at this point and you can start again. Thankfully, unspent OCP Points are carried over to the next OCP rotation. For OCPs that have enchanted line options, the items '''will not contain any line option enchants when exchanging from Timmy Boxter'''. They are only generated when opening the OCP box directly. Basically:
:40 OCP Exchange Tokens = 1 point = 1 random item
:200 OCP Exchange Tokens = 5 points = 1 SSS class (0.34%) item

title: Restoration Calculation
wikitext: This article covers the '''calculation''' of the healing amount of the [[Healing Items]]. ==Regular Consumption== For [[Healing Items#List of SP restoring items|SP healing items]], replace 2% for each [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] with 1% for each [[Stats#INT|INT]] and [[Increase HP Recovery]] with [[Increase SP Recovery]]. '''Restored Amount''' = Floor{ Floor[ Healing_Value × ( 1 + User_VIT × 0.02 + HP_Recovery_Lv × 0.1 ) ] × ( 1 + Pot_Research_Lv × 0.05 ) } *'''Healing_Value''' is a random value from the used [[Healing Items|item]]'s Healing Value. *'''User_VIT''' is the user's total [[Stats#VIT|VIT]]. *'''HP_Recovery_Lv''' is the user's skill level in [[Increase HP Recovery]]. *'''Pot_Research_Lv''' is the user's skill level in [[Potion Research]]. In English: #Pick a random value from the [[Healing Items|item]]'s Healing Value. #Increase by 2% per point of [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] or 1% per point of [[Stats#INT|INT]], and increase by 10% per level of [[Increase HP Recovery]]. Round down. #Increase by 5% per level of [[Potion Research]]. Round down. ==Aid Potion== This is an [[alchemist]] skill that allows the caster to throw potions on other characters for healing. It only works with {{item|id=501 red}}, {{item|id=502 orange}}, {{item|id=503 yellow}}, {{item|id=504 white}} and {{item|id=505 blue}} potions. For blue potions, replace 2% for each [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] with 1% for each [[Stats#INT|INT]] and [[Increase HP Recovery]] with [[Increase SP Recovery]]. '''Restored Amount''' = Floor{ Floor[ Floor( Healing_Value × ( 1 + Pot_Research_Lv × 0.05 + Aid_Potion_Lv × 0.1 ) ) × ( 1 + Target_VIT × 0.02 ) ] × [ 1 + HP_Recovery_Lv × 0.1 ] } *'''Healing_Value''' is a random value from the used [[Healing Items|item]]'s Healing Value. *'''Pot_Research_Lv''' is the caster's skill level in [[Potion Research]]. *'''Aid_Potion_Lv''' is the caster's highest skill level learned in [[Aid Potion]]. *'''Target_VIT''' is the target's total [[Stats#VIT|VIT]]. *'''HP_Recovery_Lv''' is the target's level in [[Increase HP Recovery]]. In English: #Pick a random value from the [[Healing Items|item]]'s Healing Value. #Increase by 5% per level of [[Potion Research]] and 10% per level of [[Aid Potion]]. Round down. #Increase by 2% per point of [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] or 1% per point of [[Stats#INT|INT]]. Round down. #Increase by 10% per level of [[Increase HP Recovery]]. Round down. {{Navbox Item}} [[Category: Items]]

title: Rod
wikitext:
{{Update}} Rods are equippable by a [[Priest]], [[Acolyte]], [[Mage]], [[Wizard]], [[Super Novice]], [[Sage]], [[Soul Linker]], or [[Summoner]]. Rods usually have very low [[ATK]] but give a bonus to [[MATK]], along with usually giving a bonus to [[INT]] or [[DEX]]. Rods are usually slotted, those with more than one variety may have different amounts of slots. Many rods can be purchased from [[NPC|NPCs]]. All rods are also naturally unbreakable except in upgrade attempts. == Overview ==
'''Shadow Equipment''' or '''Shadow Gear''' are ethereal magic items that are worn over your existing gear that give bonuses to your abilities in combat!
:[[File:SpecialEquipmentTab.png]]
:Shadow Equipment can be obtained from:
:*[[Shadow Item Quest]]
:*[[2019_Talk_Like_a_Pirate_Day:_The_Gilded_Galapagos|Talk Like a Pirate Day Event]]
:*[[Kachua's Secret Key]]
:*[[Kachua Mileage Coupon|Kachua Mileage Coupon Exchange]]

== Shadow Refinement ==
Shadow equipment can be [[Refinement System|refined]] by any upgrade NPC in each major towns.
*Each refinement attempt costs 20,000 [[zeny]] and {{Item|id=984 Oridecon}} or {{Item|id=985 Elunium}}.
*Refining is safe until +4 with {{item|id=984 Oridecon}}/{{Item|id=985 Elunium}}.
*Refining from +4 to +10 has a higher rate of success with {{Item|id=7620 Enriched Oridecon}}/{{Item|id=7619 Enriched Elunium}} but has a chance of breaking.
*Refining from +7 to +10 has a higher rate of success with {{Item|id=6240 HD Oridecon}}/{{Item|id=6241 HD Elunium}} and will downgrade 1 refine level if refining fails.
*{{Item|id=23926 Shadow Smelting Hammer}} is a cash shop consumables that can upgrade any shadow equipment to +9 instantly without fail.
*{{Item|id=23436 Holgren Shadow Hammer}} is a cash shop consumables that can upgrade any shadow equipment to a random upgrade level between +1 to +10 instantly without fail.

== Shadow Enchantment (Non-Class) ==
Shadow equipment can be enchanted using {{item|id=23720 Shadow Enhancement Box}}.
* The equipment must have an upgrade level of +7 or higher to be eligible to be enchanted.
* Any shadow equipment can be enchanted, except class shadow equipments (which have [[Shadow Equipment#Shadow Enchantment (Class)|their own enchantment method]]) or shadow equipment that have their own enchantment spellbook.
* Enchantment success rate is 100%.
* Each piece of shadow equipment can have a maximum of 1 enchant, and it can be overwritten simply by enchanting the same equipment again.

== Shadow Enchantment (Class) ==
*Class shadow equipment can be enchanted with stats ranging from +1 to +10.
*The equipment must have an upgrade level of +7 or higher to be eligible to be used (shadow equipment used as material will be gone).
*The box will return a new random class shadow equipment based on which class shadow box is used, with a random upgrade level between +1 to +10, and random stats ranging from +1 to +10.

title: Shaman Ring
wikitext:
The {{item | id=2777 Shaman Ring}} is an item you can obtain by buying the Ragnarok Online game for the Nintendo DS.

If you are wearing the accessory Shaman Ring and enter Glast Heim there are hidden [[NPC]]s called Sapphire that move you to 5 different locations within Glast Heim. An effect at each NPC location is visible if you are wearing the Shaman Ring and walk by one of the Sapphire locations.

*Near the entrance to Glast Heim (glast_01 365,309).
You can move to the Castle Entrance, Abbey Entrance, Chivalry Entrance or Glast Heim Culvert.

*Near the Castle Entrance (glast_01 218,293).
You can move to Glast Heim Entrance, Abbey Entrance, Chivalry Entrance or Glast Heim Culvert.

*Near the Abbey (glast_01 200,98).
You can move to the Castle Entrance, Glast Heim Entrance, Chivalry Entrance or Glast Heim Culvert.

*Near the Chilvalry entrance (glast_01 78,189).
You can move to the Castle Entrance, Abbey Entrance, Glast Heim Entrance or Glast Heim Culvert.

*Near the Glast Heim Culvert (gl_sew02 287,298).
You can move to the Castle Entrance, Abbey Entrance, Chivalry Entrance or Glast Heim Entrance.

Spear
wikitext:
Spears are used by [[Swordman]], [[Knight]], and [[Crusader]] classes. Spears have medium to high attack, and have a longer attack range than [[One Handed Sword|one]] and [[Two Handed Sword|two]] handed swords or [[dagger]]s. Spears also have a lower attack speed than the aforementioned weapons. There are many varieties of spears, many of them are slotted. Most weapon [[NPC]]s have spears of some kind for sale.

== General Overview ==

:''For a general overview: [[Equipment#Weapons | Weapons General Overview]]''

== Weapon List==

Each class has its own specialty concerning weapons (aside from TaeKwon), and some weapons are more versatile, usable by multiple classes. There are 14 types of weapons:

* [[Bows]] ([[Archer]] classes and [[Rogue]])
* [[Instruments]] ([[Bard]])
* [[Whips]] ([[Dancer]])
* [[One Handed Swords]]
* [[Two Handed Swords]] ([[Swordsman]] classes)
* [[Rods]]
* [[Maces]]
* [[Knuckles]] ([[Monk]] and [[Priest]])
* [[Books]]
* [[Daggers]]
* [[Spears]] ([[Swordsman]] classes)
* [[Katars]] ([[Assassin]])
* [[Axes]]
* [[Guns]] ([[Gunslinger]] classes)
* [[Huuma Shuriken]] ([[Ninja]] classes)

There are also "Support" weapons, which are used in conjunction with the main weapons. In the equipment window, it will show up in the center of your character's sprite. Usually these items are consumed when you execute an attack.

* [[Arrows]] ([[Archer]] classes)
* [[Bullets]] ([[Gunslinger]] classes)
* [[Cannon Ball]] ([[Mechanic]] and [[Genetic]])
* [[Shuriken]] and [[Kunai]] ([[Ninja]] classes)
* {{item|id=1771 Venom Knives}} ([[Assassin]])

== Weapon Level ==
There are 5 levels of weapon, which directly affect how that weapon is [[Refinement System|upgraded]], the effect upgrading has on that weapon, and the [[ATK]] and [[MATK]] variance of the weapon.
